sub_graphs.title: Fulu Fork Choice: Block Validation Pipeline
sub_graphs.description: Models the sequential validation checks performed on an incoming block before it is accepted into the fork choice store

nodes.label: Signed Block Received
nodes.description: A new SignedBeaconBlock has been received by the node and is pending fork choice processing

nodes.label: Check Parent Block Known
nodes.description: Assert that block.parent_root exists in store.block_states, ensuring the parent block has already been processed

nodes.label: Check Block Not In Future
nodes.description: Assert get_current_slot(store) >= block.slot, ensuring the block's slot is not ahead of the current time

nodes.label: Check Block After Finalized Slot
nodes.description: Assert block.slot > finalized_slot (compute_start_slot_at_epoch(store.finalized_checkpoint.epoch)), rejecting blocks at or before the finalized epoch boundary

nodes.label: Check Finalized Ancestry
nodes.description: Assert the block descends from the finalized checkpoint block by verifying get_checkpoint_block matches store.finalized_checkpoint.root

nodes.label: Check Data Availability (Fulu Modified)
nodes.description: Assert is_data_available(hash_tree_root(block)) succeeds, verifying that all required column sidecars can be retrieved and verified

nodes.label: Block Passed All Pre-Checks
nodes.description: The block has passed all validation assertions and is ready for state transition execution

nodes.label: Execute State Transition
nodes.description: Run state_transition(state, signed_block, True) to compute the post-state and verify the block is valid

nodes.label: Block Rejected (Assertion Failure)
nodes.description: Any assertion failure causes the block to be rejected and not added to the store

sub_graphs.title: Fulu Fork Choice: Data Availability Sampling via Column Sidecars
sub_graphs.description: Models the data availability check that replaced blob-based availability in Fulu, using column sidecars with KZG proof verification

nodes.label: Data Availability Check Initiated
nodes.description: is_data_available called with beacon_block_root, beginning column sidecar retrieval

nodes.label: Retrieve Column Sidecars
nodes.description: Implementation-dependent retrieval of column sidecars for sampling. Replaces retrieve_blobs_and_proofs. May raise exception if sidecars are unavailable.

nodes.label: Column Sidecars Retrieved
nodes.description: All required column sidecars for sampling have been retrieved from the P2P network or local storage

nodes.label: Verify Data Column Sidecar
nodes.description: Call verify_data_column_sidecar(column_sidecar) to validate the structural integrity and format of each column sidecar

nodes.label: Verify Column Sidecar KZG Proofs
nodes.description: Call verify_data_column_sidecar_kzg_proofs(column_sidecar) to cryptographically verify each sidecar's KZG proofs

nodes.label: Data Availability Confirmed
nodes.description: All column sidecars passed both format and KZG proof verification

nodes.label: Data Availability Failed
nodes.description: Column sidecars could not be retrieved, or one or more failed verification. Block may be queued for later.

edges.label: Format valid, proceed to KZG verification

external_entities.name: P2P Network Peers
external_entities.description: Peer nodes providing column sidecars. Availability not guaranteed beyond MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS_REQUESTS epochs.

sub_graphs.title: Fulu Fork Choice: Store State Updates After Block Acceptance
sub_graphs.description: Models how the fork choice store is updated after a block passes all validation and state transition

nodes.label: Parent State Copied
nodes.description: A mutable copy of store.block_states[block.parent_root] has been created to avoid mutability issues

nodes.label: Execute State Transition
nodes.description: Run state_transition(state, signed_block, True) computing the post-state and verifying block validity

nodes.label: Add Block to Store
nodes.description: Set store.blocks[block_root] = block, making the block available for future fork choice

nodes.label: Add Block State to Store
nodes.description: Set store.block_states[block_root] = state, storing the post-state for this block

nodes.label: Record Block Timeliness
nodes.description: Call record_block_timeliness(store, block_root) to track when the block was received relative to its slot

nodes.label: Update Proposer Boost Root
nodes.description: Call update_proposer_boost_root(store, block_root) to apply proposer boost scoring for fork choice

nodes.label: Update Checkpoints
nodes.description: Call update_checkpoints(store, state.current_justified_checkpoint, state.finalized_checkpoint) to advance finality

nodes.label: Compute Pulled-Up Tip
nodes.description: Call compute_pulled_up_tip(store, block_root) to eagerly compute unrealized justification and finality

nodes.label: Fork Choice Store Fully Updated
nodes.description: The store now contains the new block, its post-state, updated checkpoints, proposer boost, and pulled-up tip computation

edges.label: Copied parent state passed to state transition

ambiguities.text: retrieve_column_sidecars is implementation and context dependent
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume retrieve_column_sidecars must return exactly the set of column sidecars needed for the node's data availability sampling requirements (per its custody responsibilities). The exact subset is determined by the DAS configuration. This is an assumption that needs cross-reference with the DAS core spec.

ambiguities.text: If not, this payload MAY be queued and subsequently considered when blob data becomes available
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'MAY be queued' means implementations are permitted but not required to buffer blocks with unavailable data for later reprocessing. This introduces implementation-dependent behavior where some nodes may queue and others may drop.

ambiguities.text: No specification of what 'all column sidecars to sample' means in terms of count or selection criteria
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the sampling set is defined in the DAS core spec (custody column count and selection algorithm). The fork choice spec delegates this entirely. Cross-reference with fulu/das-core.md is needed.

ambiguities.text: The p2p network does not guarantee sidecar retrieval outside of MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS_REQUESTS epochs
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume that is_data_available will fail (raise exception or return false) for blocks older than MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS_REQUESTS epochs if sidecars were not previously cached locally. This creates a time-bounded data availability window.

implicit_assumptions.description: The KZG proof verification (verify_data_column_sidecar_kzg_proofs) is assumed to be cryptographically sound, meaning a valid proof can only be produced from correctly-encoded column data.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: An attacker could forge KZG proofs for invalid column data, causing nodes to accept blocks with corrupted or unavailable data, breaking the data availability guarantee.

implicit_assumptions.description: Sufficient peers in the P2P network hold and serve the required column sidecars within the MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS_REQUESTS window.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Nodes may be unable to verify data availability for valid blocks, causing them to reject valid blocks and potentially stall or fork the chain.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot selectively withhold specific column sidecars from targeted nodes while making them available to others, beyond what the DAS sampling probability allows.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Targeted data withholding attacks could cause specific nodes to reject valid blocks, leading to inconsistent fork choice views and potential chain splits.

implicit_assumptions.description: The copy(store.block_states[block.parent_root]) operation creates a deep copy that fully isolates the new state from the parent state in the store.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Shared mutable state between parent and child block states could cause state corruption when processing subsequent blocks, leading to incorrect fork choice decisions.

implicit_assumptions.description: The verify_data_column_sidecar function validates structural integrity sufficiently to prevent malformed sidecars from causing crashes or undefined behavior in downstream processing.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Malformed column sidecars could exploit parsing vulnerabilities, potentially causing denial of service or memory corruption in client implementations.
